shared: Edit the supplied approved in-game sprite reference canvas into one production sprite animation sheet. OUTPUT: exactly 1536x1024 transparent RGBA PNG, SIX equally spaced 512x512 slots in 3 columns and 2 rows, reading left-to-right top row then bottom row. The first supplied character in top-left is the identity and scale reference, not a guide to leave the rest blank. Fill all six slots with the same character performing the full continuous move. Same right-facing side view in every slot, same hand-drawn colored-pencil texture, black outlines, same silhouette proportions, face, hair, clothing and palette as the reference. Character standing height about 300px in each 512px cell; bottom-center anchor x=256 and ground baseline y=440 relative to every cell; crouch or airborne poses may move naturally relative to that fixed anchor. Keep every body and effect completely inside its own slot with generous transparent gaps. Do not let adjacent slots touch. Crisp readable face at game scale. NO scenery, floor, shadows, labels, numbers, text, borders, grid lines or checkerboard. Background must be genuinely transparent. This is a sprite sheet, not a poster.
